text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Fest, and<n>plenty of
activities are being held for<n>fans to enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Ticket?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! Help me, Hayahideee!
choice_data_list: You seem to be in a bind...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I am! I'm in a huge bind, and I needHayahide's help!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket is nearly<n>incomprehensible in her
distress, so<n>we follow her to find out what's<n>going
on.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's time for the brain strain trivia<n>game! Make
some noise, everyone!<n>We're about to find out who
will<n>receive the Trivia Crown!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Uh, what?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why, if it isn't Biwa Hayahide. Were<n>you entered
into this unwittingly as<n>well?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: A-actually, yes...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry. But we do sincerely<n>appreciate an
Umamusume of your<n>stature joining the
proceedings.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There were some issues with the<n>equipment for the
event planned for<n>this time slot, so a trivia show
was<n>created to fill the gap.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that's why Ticket was so<n>desperate for
my help.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's just a little diversion until the<n>equipment is
repaired. There's<n>nothing to it, so let's take it easy
and<n>enjoy ourselves, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You've got this, Prez!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
First question! How many courses<n>have a turf track
with a height<n>difference of three me—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Ping!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Five. The courses with a height<n>difference of three
meters or more<n>are Nakayama, Kyoto, Chukyo,
Kokura, and Hakodate.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's... correct! The question was,<n>"How many
courses have a turf track<n>with a height difference of
three<n>meters or more?" And the answer is<n>five!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wow! You're amazing!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Now, now, Teio. Audience<n>members must
remain in their seats.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Who's the one who said we should<n>"take this
easy" again? She's<n>obviously playing to win!)

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf is incredible! Come on,<n>Hayahide! You can
do it!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(I can't back down now, though. I<n>don't want to let
my fans down.)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hayahideee! You can do it! Look, I<n>brought some
support!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I came like you asked and she saw<n>me... So can I
leave now?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (Brian?! What's she doing here?)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aw, come on! She needs our support!<n>Let's cheer
for her together! Ready,<n>and...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You can do it, Hayahideee!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What incredibly loud cheering... Oh, is<n>that Brian?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Question number two! How long is the<n>To—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Ping!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
525.9 meters. If you're asking about<n>the length of
the track at Tokyo<n>Racecourse, that is.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Correct! The answer is indeed 525<n>meters!
Hayahide's not to be<n>outdone with that
lightning-fast<n>answer!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I can't believe you dragged meinto this, Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The battle for the Trivia Crown rages<n>on until,
finally, a winner is decided.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And the winner of the Trivia Crown<n>is... President
Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! I knew you'd win, Prez!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're too much, Teio. Don't<n>you need to
prepare for the next<n>event?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... But if I'd only gotten one<n>more
question right...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide looks frustrated and<n>just a touch
fatigued as she lets out<n>another sigh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I can't believe you dragged meinto this, Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The battle for the Trivia Crown rages<n>on until,
finally, a winner is decided.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And the winner of the Trivia Crown<n>is... Biwa
Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I couldn't have done it without<n>everyone
rooting for me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hayahide, you nailed it! And thankssooooo much for agreeing to join!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Goodness... Just so you know, the<n>next time
you're in trouble, I won't<n>agree to help before I
squeeze every<n>last detail out of you!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Also, um...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Are you by yourself right now?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I sure am!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But! Brian was with me until just alittle while ago!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I saw her kinda smile a little when<n>you won!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That's nice to hear.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide's face glows with a<n>bashful smile.
